notes: Manufacturer data sheet (TESDS-381-2103-EN-R2) with a labeled back-panel photo used as the authoritative source. The AMP-450BP is a 4-channel PoE+ conferencing amplifier acting as a Tesira AVB endpoint; it has no rack ears (compact desktop/ceiling-mount enclosure, ~30x195x120mm) so rackUnits is omitted. Only one physical RJ-45 (AVB/Control) exists for network+control, and power arrives over that same jack via PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at Class 4, 30W) rather than through a discrete power connector — modeled as a bidirectional network port rather than a separate power port. The four "Amp Out" RJ-45 jacks carry proprietary speaker-level analog output (a termination-free alternative to euroblock — an optional CCA euroblock-to-category adapter accessory converts them back to euroblock) — they are NOT Ethernet-graded, so no eth-* grade was applied to them, only to the AVB/Control port which the spec confirms is Gigabit Ethernet. Optional accessories (CCA euroblock adapter, Seismic Cable Adapter, TB-1 tile bridge, plenum boxes) exist but were not modeled as native ports since they are add-ons.

ports.name: AVB / Control
ports.note: Gigabit Ethernet (Cat 5e and above); carries Tesira AVB digital audio + control data. Also serves as the power input: labeled 'PoE+ Class 4' on the back panel — the device is powered entirely via PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at Class 4, 30W) through this single port; there is no separate AC/DC power inlet.

ports.name: Amp Out 1
ports.note: Speaker-level analog output (not Ethernet-graded); termination-free RJ-45 connection to compatible speakers such as the Desono C-IC6. 3W continuous per channel (all 4 channels driven), up to 50W burst into a 4-ohm load.
